description.value: Strathcona North is the North Shore waterfront outpost of Strathcona Beer Company, situated at Lonsdale Quay with an interior blending natural wood, marble, brass, and a large indoor tree for an indoor-outdoor feel. It offers a full food program spanning lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch alongside house-brewed craft beers and cocktails. An on-site bottle shop lets cyclists pick up takeaway Strathcona and LOLO products to go.

address.value: 123 Carrie Cates Court #108, North Vancouver, BC V7M 3K7
